l1_words.meaning: secretary (a person who handles office work)

pattern_explanation: The Polish words and their English look-alikes share a close spelling, so learners may assume the English word has the same meaning. The English word has a different meaning in this context, so the learner has to map each Polish word to its true English equivalent, as in a community group describing a project as environmentally friendly.
false_friend_warning: Warning: the Polish word 'aktualny' means current or up to date, but the English word 'actual' means real or existing. Also, 'eventually' means in the end, not 'possibly', so the Polish word 'ewentualnie' does not translate as 'eventually'.
